evidencePolicy.externalSourceRequirement: Repair, turn management, completion, aspect, serialization, benefactive, directional, temporal-class, particle, register, and phonological conclusions require independently checkable Cantonese evidence.
evidencePolicy.corpusRule: Attestation or an existing runtime owner does not establish unrestricted productivity, preferred parsing, register, dialect-wide naturalness, or linguistic status.

sources.citation: Glossika Cantonese (HK) A1, Week 18, Cantonese – Common Verbs, 2026-07-19
sources.scope: Exact source forms, order, readings, translations, register labels, particle glosses, and phonics claims only.

sources.citation: Liesenfeld, Andreas Maria. 2019. Cantonese turn-initial minimal particles: annotation of discourse-interactional functions in dialog corpora. PACLIC 33:471–479.
sources.scope: Twenty hours of naturally occurring Cantonese dialog support interactional distinctions among continuers, responses, change-of-state tokens, turn-management tokens, and repair initiators, conditioned by sequential position, pitch, and production format.

sources.citation: Luke, K. K. 1990. Utterance Particles in Cantonese Conversation.
sources.scope: Naturally occurring interaction shows that LA, LO, and WO resist one fixed truth-conditional or grammatical gloss and require conversation-sequential analysis.

sources.citation: Sybesma, Rint, and Boya Li. 2007. The dissection and structural mapping of Cantonese sentence final particles. Lingua 117(10):1739–1783.
sources.scope: Cantonese final particles form a structured, tone-sensitive system whose meanings cannot be replaced by one-word English labels.

sources.citation: Cheung, Lawrence Yam-Leung. 2021. The origin and development of the question particle me1 in Cantonese. Lingua 254:103049.
sources.scope: Modern sentence-final me1 has biased and discourse uses and negative-presupposition associations; older unbiased uses do not license a neutral modern rule.

sources.citation: Lei, Margaret Ka-yan, and Thomas Hun-tak Lee. 2019. Differentiating universal quantification from completive aspect in child Cantonese.
sources.scope: The aspectual verb jyun4 ‘finish’ expresses event completion and is distinct from saai3 universal quantification.

sources.citation: Yiu, Carine Yuk Man. Directional verbs in Cantonese: A typological and historical study.
sources.scope: Cantonese uses both directional verbs and directional complements; agentive motion and degree of fusion differ from Mandarin, so independent motion verbs and directional elements must remain distinguishable.

sources.citation: Luke, K. K., and Adams Bodomo. 2001. A comparative study of the semantics of serial verb constructions in Dagaare and Cantonese. Languages in Contrast 3(2):165–180.
sources.scope: Cantonese serial-verb semantics includes benefactive, causative/resultative, inceptive, instrumental, and deictic serialization; surface multi-verb strings require subtype-specific analysis.

sources.citation: Bodomo, Adams, Olivia Lam, and Natalie Yu. 2003. Double Object and Serial Verb Benefactive Constructions in Cantonese. LFG03 Proceedings.
sources.scope: Cantonese distinguishes single-verb double-object benefactives from serial-verb benefactives, with different form and possible conceptual nuances.

sources.citation: Tong, Malindy, Michael Yell, and Cliff Goddard. 1997. Semantic primitives of time and space in Hong Kong Cantonese. Language Sciences 19(3):245–261.
sources.scope: Hong Kong Cantonese has distinct temporal exponents for time/when, now, before, after, long time, and short time, with some combinatorial restrictions.

sources.citation: Tse, Shek Kam, Hui Li, and Shing On Leung. 2014. Tense and temporality: How young children express time in Cantonese.
sources.scope: Naturalistic Cantonese child conversations yielded distinct inventories of temporal nouns, temporal adverbs, and aspect markers; temporal vocabulary is not one homogeneous lexical class.

sources.citation: Lam, Charles, Chaak-ming Lau, and Jackson L. Lee. 2024. Multi-Tiered Cantonese Word Segmentation. LREC-COLING 2024:11993–12002.
sources.scope: Cantonese numeral expressions retain internal compositional structure even when grouped at a word-level segmentation tier.

sources.citation: Bauer, Robert S., and Paul K. Benedict. 1997. Modern Cantonese Phonology.
sources.scope: Reference Cantonese vowel, syllable, and tone analysis for independent item-level phonics verification.

claims.claim: The clarification and interruption examples are interactional actions whose interpretation depends on sequence, participation context, prosody, and formulation; they do not establish one repair or turn-management construction.
claims.boundary: Keep repetition requests, reference clarification, meaning clarification, interruption, floor holding, and politeness formulae separate until direct item-level evidence supports a shared profile.

claims.claim: The source labels Casual and Polite are pedagogical metadata rather than established sociolinguistic features.
claims.boundary: No register feature or dialect-wide acceptability conclusion follows without corpus distribution and role-neutral speaker evidence.

claims.claim: 講完 contains the completion predicate or aspectual verb 完 jyun4; completion must remain distinct from perfective marking and from universal saai3.
claims.boundary: Do not infer that every V完 sequence has identical syntax, argument structure, aspectual scope, or compatibility with particles.

claims.claim: 你食咗飯未 attests a perfective clause followed by 未 in a completion-state question, but the single item does not establish one unrestricted neutral aspect-question rule.
claims.boundary: Require contrasts with bare 未, sentence-final particles, experiential 過, lexical completion, context, and answer profiles before broadening any question analysis.

claims.claim: 我要返屋企煮飯 and 我去超市買嘢 contain motion followed by an activity or purpose predicate; they are candidates for serial or motion-purpose composition, not automatically directional-complement constructions.
claims.boundary: Independent motion verb, destination, purpose relation, and directional complement must be diagnosed separately.

claims.claim: 我留喺屋企睇電視 combines a stay predicate, a locative phrase, and an activity predicate; source attestation does not establish a single catch-all locative-continuation construction.
claims.boundary: Clause integration, shared subject, aspect, prosody, and alternative coordination require direct contrasts.

claims.claim: 咁我幫你買嘢返嚟啦 combines a discourse linker, a 幫 benefactive relation, a buying event, deictic return material, and a final particle; these layers must not be flattened into one construction.
claims.boundary: Beneficiary, helper/agent, theme, motion path, deictic center, and particle contribution require separate ownership and tests.

claims.claim: Twenty-four of the twenty-five common verbs already have exact modular token-lexicon owners; 著 zoek3 ‘wear’ is the sole lexical-review gap.
claims.boundary: The audit authorizes no runtime addition and keeps 著 zoek3 distinct from homographic aspectual, resultative, or pronunciation profiles.

claims.claim: The temporal list mixes part-of-day nouns, period and unit nouns, schedule or artifact nouns, scalar temporal forms, relational forms, duration or recurrence forms, and an interval noun.
claims.boundary: The project audit classes are review aids, not final universal parts of speech, and no item is licensed as a bare clause-level modifier from its English gloss alone.

claims.claim: Only three of the twenty-eight temporal entries have exact modular lexical coverage; the remaining twenty-five require lexical-whole, compositionality, register, reading, and owner review.
claims.boundary: No bulk lexical ingress, formal-to-colloquial substitution, or automatic temporal-adverb classification is authorized.

claims.claim: 一億 through 十億 remain compositional numeral expressions; one source list does not justify ten opaque whole-form entries.
claims.boundary: Keep coefficient, 億 unit, English-value verification, and cross-week deduplication explicit.

claims.claim: The source's one-word sentence-final-particle glosses are pedagogical approximations and cannot replace tone-sensitive, sequential, combinatorial, and stance analysis.
claims.boundary: Do not assign a single fixed function to 呀, 啦, 喇, 㗎, 嘅, 嘛, 喎, 噃, 咩, 囉, or 啩 from this table.

claims.claim: Modern sentence-final me1 is not adequately characterized as merely a rhetorical-question marker; it has biased and discourse uses associated with negative presuppositions.
claims.boundary: The example 真係咩 requires discourse-context analysis and cannot donate a neutral polar-question rule.

claims.claim: The phonics heading and six rows require independent item-level verification; the source contains an incomplete 香 / — row and the heading does not transparently describe every listed pair.
claims.boundary: No pronunciation-resource ingress, silent completion, pair acceptance, or contrast generalization is authorized.

disposition.nextEvidence: Use the follow-up ledger for bounded corpus inventories, canonical parser audits, direct lexical review, or role-neutral panel items only after research and corpus evidence remain inconclusive.
